title: Authorized Users on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card
content:
**Cardholder agreement — authorized users.**

1. Only the primary cardholder may add or remove authorized users. An authorized user may make purchases but cannot make account changes.
2. Authorized users can be added only while the account status is active.
3. The number of authorized users may never exceed the tier's authorized-user ceiling; each must be at least the tier's minimum age on the day added; and at most the tier's change limit of additions or removals is processed in one statement period.
4. Ridgeline Project Loans have no authorized users.
5. Removing an authorized user is allowed in any open status and does not count against the limit of additions.

## Questions answered

**An authorized user asks to change the autopay on the card.** An authorized user cannot make account changes.

**A primary cardholder on a suspended card asks to add a family member.** Additions are made only while the account is active.

**Hypothetical: a person who turns 16 tomorrow, on a tier with a minimum age of 16.** The person does not meet the age requirement today; on their sixteenth birthday they do.

**Hypothetical: an account at its ceiling with one authorized user to remove.** The removal is allowed and does not count against the additions limit.
